1.word_for_word: सप्त-त्रिंशे हते केशिन्य्- अच्युतो भावि-कर्मभिः । — When Keśinī was killed in the thirty-seventh year, Acyuta was killed by his future deeds.; नारदेन स्तुतः क्रीडन् व्योमासुरम् अथावधीत् ॥ — Praised by Nārada, the Lord, while playing, killed the demon Vyomāsura.; वृषवेषासुरं यद्वत् केशिनं हय-वेषिणम् । — Just as a demon dressed as a bull, Keśī dressed as a horse,; कंस-प्राण-सखं हत्वा कंसं व्यसुम् इवाकरोत् ॥ — He killed Kaṁsa’s lifelong friend and made him look like a dead man.; केशी त्व् इति । — Keshi Tv is.; प्रथम-श्लोकेन य एवं-भूतः केशीत्य् अनूद्य तं भगवान् उपाह्वयद् इति द्वितीयेनान्वयः । — The second consequence is that the Lord, translating the first verse as Keśī, who thus became, called him.; महा-हयः सन् महीं निर्जरयन् श्लथयन् विदारयन्न् इत्य् अर्थः । — It means that he was a great horse, burning, slipping and tearing the earth.; सटाभिः केसरैर् अवधूतानीतस् ततः क्षिप्तान्य् अभ्राणि विमानानि च तैः सङ्कीर्णं नभः कुर्वन् । — The sky was crowded with clouds and airplanes thrown down by the saffron trees; हेषितैर् अश्व-जाति-शब्दैर् भीषितम् अखिलं विश्वं येन सः ॥१॥ — He who frightened the whole universe with his laughing horse-breed sounds.
1.translation: When Keśinī was killed in the thirty-seventh year, Acyuta was killed by his future deeds. Praised by Nārada, the Lord, while playing, killed the demon Vyomāsura. Just as a demon dressed as a bull, Keśī dressed as a horse, He killed Kaṁsa’s lifelong friend and made him look like a dead man. Keshi Tv is. The second consequence is that the Lord, translating the first verse as Keśī, who thus became, called him. It means that he was a great horse, burning, slipping and tearing the earth. The sky was crowded with clouds and airplanes thrown down by the saffron trees He who frightened the whole universe with his laughing horse-breed sounds.

2.word_for_word: तद्-धेषितैर् स्तैरतिनिष्ठुरैर् हेषितैः । — They were laughed at by those very cruel laughs.; बालैः पुच्छ-लोमभिर् विघूर्णिताः परिभ्रामिता अम्बुदा येन तम् । — The clouds that spun around with the hairs of their tails were spun around by the children.; आजौ सङ्ग्रामार्थम् । — Today, for the sake of fighting.; आत्मानं कृष्णम् । — The self is black.; अग्रणीः पुरतो निर्गतः सन्न् उपाह्वयत् स्व-समीपम् आजुहाव । — The leader came out in front of him and called out to him.; स च केशी तन् निशम्य मृगेन्द्र-वन् नादम् अकरोत् ॥२॥ — And that Keshi, hearing that, roared like a lion.
2.translation: They were laughed at by those very cruel laughs. The clouds that spun around with the hairs of their tails were spun around by the children. Today, for the sake of fighting. The self is black. The leader came out in front of him and called out to him. And that Keshi, hearing that, roared like a lion.

3.word_for_word: ततः केशी तं कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा मुखेन खं पिबन्न् इव मुखं विवृत्याभिमुखः सन्न् अभिजगाम । — Then Keśī, seeing Kṛṣṇa, approached him, opening his mouth as if drinking the sky with his mouth.; किं च अत्य्-अमर्षणोऽति-कुपितोऽत्यन्तम् असहमानो वा । — What about being extremely impatient, extremely angry, or extremely intolerant?; प्रत्यक् यद्भ्यां जघान । — directly with which he struck.; दुरासदोऽन्यैर् अभिभवितुम् अशक्यः । — He is difficult to overcome and cannot be attacked by others; दुरत्ययः उद्यतः सन् दुरतिक्रमः । — It is difficult to overcome, and it is difficult to overcome.; अत्र हेतुः, चण्ड-जवश् चण्डस् तीव्रो जवो वेगो धावनं यस्य ॥३॥ — The reason for this is that the speed of the fierce is the fierce speed of which the speed of the running is intense.
3.translation: Then Keśī, seeing Kṛṣṇa, approached him, opening his mouth as if drinking the sky with his mouth. What about being extremely impatient, extremely angry, or extremely intolerant? directly with which he struck. He is difficult to overcome and cannot be attacked by others It is difficult to overcome, and it is difficult to overcome. The reason for this is that the speed of the fierce is the fierce speed of which the speed of the running is intense.

4.word_for_word: तद् धननं वञ्चयित्वा तं च हननाय प्रसारितयोः पादयोर् हस्ताभ्यां गृहीत्वा परिविध्य भ्रामयित्वा व्यवस्थितस् तथैव स्थितो बभूव ॥४॥ — Having deceived the wealth he seized him with his hands when his legs were outstretched to kill him and turned him about and stood still.
4.translation: Having deceived the wealth he seized him with his hands when his legs were outstretched to kill him and turned him about and stood still.

5.word_for_word: व्यादाय मुखं प्रसार्य वेगेन हरिं प्रत्य् आद्रवत् । — She opened her mouth and ran swiftly toward the Lord.; सोऽपि हरिर् हसन्न् उत्तरं सव्यं भुजम् । — The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, laughed and raised His left arm.; निर्मयत्वे दृष्टान्तः, यथोरगं बिल इति ॥५॥ — The illustration of the creation, as in the case of a snake, is a cave.
5.translation: She opened her mouth and ran swiftly toward the Lord. The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, laughed and raised His left arm. The illustration of the creation, as in the case of a snake, is a cave.

6.word_for_word: ततः किं तद् आह---दन्ता इति । — Then what is that, he says, teeth?; चर्वणाय भगवद्-भुजं स्पृशन्तीति तथा ते व्यादानेन ये विवृताः । — They touched the arm of the Lord to chew, and so did those who were opened by the opening.; अयो लोहं स्पृशन्तीति स्पृशः । — Ayo touches the iron, and touches it.; यद्वा तप्त-मयम् अति-तप्तं लोहादि स्पृशन्तो यथेति । — Or, as when touching a hot object, such as iron, which is very hot.; आमयो जलोदरम् ॥६॥ — Amayo Jalodaram.
6.translation: Then what is that, he says, teeth? They touched the arm of the Lord to chew, and so did those who were opened by the opening. Ayo touches the iron, and touches it. Or, as when touching a hot object, such as iron, which is very hot. Amayo Jalodaram.

7.word_for_word: लेण्डं पुरीषम् उत्सृजन् ॥७॥ — They released the lend and the male.
7.translation: They released the lend and the male.

8.word_for_word: कर्कटिका-फलं हि पद्वं साद्यन्तं विदीर्णं भवति तद्वद् विदीर्णात् तस्य देहात् । — The fruit of the cancerous tree is torn from its body when it is torn from its body.; व्यसोर् विगत-प्राणात् । — from the departed life of Vyasor.; अविस्मितो गर्व-रहितः । — Unsurprised, without pride.; अयत्नेन हतोऽरिर् येन सः ॥८॥ — He who killed the enemy without effort.; कंसाय कृष्णम् आदिश्य तद्-रहस्यादि-पैशुनैः । — He ordered Kṛṣṇa to Kaṁsa and told him the secrets and other deceptions.; कंस-घातादि कृष्णस्य कार्यम् आवेदयन् मुनिः ॥ — The sage reported to Lord Kṛṣṇa about the killing of Kaṁsa.
8.translation: The fruit of the cancerous tree is torn from its body when it is torn from its body. from the departed life of Vyasor. Unsurprised, without pride. He who killed the enemy without effort. He ordered Kṛṣṇa to Kaṁsa and told him the secrets and other deceptions. The sage reported to Lord Kṛṣṇa about the killing of Kaṁsa.

9.word_for_word: तदाह---देवर्षिर् इत्य्-आदिना । — Then he says, "The sage of the gods," etc.; न चायं सूचकः किन्तु सर्व-सुहृद् इत्य् आह---भागवत-प्रवर इति ॥९॥ — This is not an indicator but a friend of all, he argues, for he is the foremost of the devotees.
9.translation: Then he says, "The sage of the gods," etc. This is not an indicator but a friend of all, he argues, for he is the foremost of the devotees.

10.word_for_word: अस्मद्-रहस्यं वैरिणि कंसे सूचितवन् इति मा शङ्कीर् इत्य् आह---कृष्ण कृष्णेत्य्-आदिना । — “Do not doubt that you have informed our enemy Kaṁsa of our secret,” he said, “Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa.”; अयं भावः, त्वम् ईश्वरो भू-भार-दैत्य-संहारायवतीर्णोऽसि, अतस् तद्-अनुरुपाचरणेन विश्वं परिपालयेति । — This means that You, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, have descended to destroy the demons who burden the earth, and therefore protect the universe by acting accordingly.; तत्र त्वयि तवद् भय-शङ्कैव नास्तीत्य् आह---अप्रमेयात्मन्न् अपरिच्छिन्न-रूप । — There is no fear or doubt in You, he argues, for You are the immeasurable Self, the unbroken form.; योगेशाचिन्त्य-प्रभव । — Yogesh Chintya-Prabha.; जगद्-ईश्वर विश्व-नियन्तः । — He is the God of the universe and the controller of the universe.; वासुदेव सर्व-भूतेषु वर्तमान । — Vāsudeva is present in all beings.; अखिलावास सर्वस्याश्रय । — Akhilavas is the shelter of all.; संप्रति सात्वतां प्रवर श्रेष्ठ । — At present, the best of the Sattvas is the best.; प्रभो सर्व-शक्ते ॥१०॥ — Lord, all-powerful.
10.translation: “Do not doubt that you have informed our enemy Kaṁsa of our secret,” he said, “Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa.” This means that You, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, have descended to destroy the demons who burden the earth, and therefore protect the universe by acting accordingly. There is no fear or doubt in You, he argues, for You are the immeasurable Self, the unbroken form. Yogesh Chintya-Prabha. He is the God of the universe and the controller of the universe. Vāsudeva is present in all beings. Akhilavas is the shelter of all. At present, the best of the Sattvas is the best. Lord, all-powerful.

11.word_for_word: कथम् एवं-रूपोऽहम् इति चेद् अत आह---त्वम् आत्मेति । — If we ask how I am in such a form, then he argues that You are the Self.; न हि त्वं जीव-वत् परिच्छिन्नः किन्तु सर्व-भूतानाम् आन्तर एकोऽनुस्यूत आत्मा । — You are not disconnected like a living entity, but you are one indwelling soul within all beings.; अन्तर् अनुस्यूतत्वे दृष्टान्तः, एधसां काष्ठानाम् अन्तर् ज्योतिर् इवेति । — The illustration of the inner being followed is like the light within the wood of the edhas.; भूतेषु स्थितोऽपि तैर् न दृश्यस इत्य् आह---गूढ इति । — He argues that even though you are in the beings, you are not visible to them, because you are hidden.; अत्र हेतवः, गुहाशयो बुद्धेर् अप्य् आन्तरः । — Here the causes, the cave, are also within the intellect.; किं च साक्षी । — And what about the witness.; न हि साक्षी दृश्यत इत्य् अर्थः । — This does not mean that the witness is visible.; अपि च महा-पुरुषः । — Also a great man.; अतः परिच्छिन्न-मतिभिर् न ज्ञायस इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that you are not known by disconnected minds.; तर्हि सर्वान्तरत्वे किं प्रमाणम् अत आह---ईश्वर इति । — What, then, is the evidence for the omnipresence?; न हीश्वरं विना पर-तन्त्राणां जीवानां प्रवृत्तिर् घटत इत्य् अर्थः ॥११॥ — This means that the instincts of living beings under the control of others do not take place without God.
11.translation: If we ask how I am in such a form, then he argues that You are the Self. You are not disconnected like a living entity, but you are one indwelling soul within all beings. The illustration of the inner being followed is like the light within the wood of the edhas. He argues that even though you are in the beings, you are not visible to them, because you are hidden. Here the causes, the cave, are also within the intellect. And what about the witness. This does not mean that the witness is visible. Also a great man. This means that you are not known by disconnected minds. What, then, is the evidence for the omnipresence? This means that the instincts of living beings under the control of others do not take place without God.

12.word_for_word: अहम् ईश्वरोऽन्यत्-सर्वम् ईशितव्यम् इत्य् एतद् एव कुत इत्य् अत आह---आत्मनेति । — I am God, and everything else is to be worshipped. Where is this?; साधनान्तर-निरपेक्ष एवात्माश्रयः स्व-तन्त्रः मायया शक्त्या भवान् गुणान् ससृजे सृष्टवान् । — You are self-sufficient, independent of any other means, and by Your illusory power You created the modes of nature.; तैः सृष्टैर् गुणैर् इदं विश्वं सृजसि अत्सि संहरसि अवसि पालयसि । — By these created qualities You create this universe, You create it, You destroy it, You maintain it in the earth.; ननु सृष्ट्य्-आदि-क्रिया पट्कारक-साध्यैव दृष्टेत्य् आह---सत्य-सङ्कल्प इति । — Indeed, it is argued that the actions of creation and others are seen as achievable by the pattern-maker, and that it is a true resolution.; न हि सङ्कल्पैक-साध्ये बहिः साधनापेक्षेति भावः । — This means that there is no need for external means to be achieved by a single resolution.; अतस् त्वम् ईश्वर इत्य् उपसंहारः ॥१२॥ — Therefore, you are the Lord, the conclusion.
12.translation: I am God, and everything else is to be worshipped. Where is this? You are self-sufficient, independent of any other means, and by Your illusory power You created the modes of nature. By these created qualities You create this universe, You create it, You destroy it, You maintain it in the earth. Indeed, it is argued that the actions of creation and others are seen as achievable by the pattern-maker, and that it is a true resolution. This means that there is no need for external means to be achieved by a single resolution. Therefore, you are the Lord, the conclusion.

13.word_for_word: प्रस्तुतम् आह---स त्वम् इति । — He said to the presenter, "That is you.; भू-धर-भूतानां भुवं धरन्तीति भू-धरा राजानस् तद्-रूपाणाम् ॥१३.१४॥ — The earth-bearers are the kings of the earth-bearers in their forms, for they hold the earth.
13.translation: He said to the presenter, "That is you. The earth-bearers are the kings of the earth-bearers in their forms, for they hold the earth.

15.word_for_word: परश्वोऽहनीति । — It’s the next day.; अद्यैवाक्रूर एष्यति, श्वो मथुरां गन्तासि, पर-श्वश् चाणूरादींश् च त्वया निहतान् द्रक्ष्यामीति सिद्धवन् निर्देशो विज्ञपन-प्रकार-विशेषः ॥१५॥ — The instruction that Akrura will come today, tomorrow you will go to Mathura, and the next day I will see Cāṇūra and others killed by you is a special kind of announcement.
15.translation: It’s the next day. The instruction that Akrura will come today, tomorrow you will go to Mathura, and the next day I will see Cāṇūra and others killed by you is a special kind of announcement.

16.word_for_word: तस्यानु तद्-अनन्तरम् । — After that, it’s after that.; शङ्खादीनाम् । — of conches and others.; शङ्खः पञ्च-जनः । — The conch is five-people.; वधं द्रक्ष्यामीति शेषः । — The rest is to see the killing.; भावि-निर्देश-मात्रम् एतत्, न त्व् आनन्तर्यं विवक्षितम् ॥१६.१७॥ — This is only an indication of the future, and not the future.
16.translation: After that, it’s after that. of conches and others. The conch is five-people. The rest is to see the killing. This is only an indication of the future, and not the future.

18.word_for_word: भार्यया जाम्बवत्या सह । — with his wife Jambavati.; स्व-धामतो महा-काल-पुरात् ॥१८.१९॥ — From his own abode, the great city of time.
18.translation: with his wife Jambavati. From his own abode, the great city of time.

20.word_for_word: द्वारकाम् आवसन् द्वारकायां वसन् । — They lived in Dwarka and lived in Dwarka.; कर्ता करिष्यति ॥२०॥ — The doer will do it.
20.translation: They lived in Dwarka and lived in Dwarka. The doer will do it.

21.word_for_word: अमुष्य विश्वस्य भूभारस्य वा ॥२१॥ — This world or the burden of the earth.
21.translation: This world or the burden of the earth.

22.word_for_word: अमुष्य विश्वस्य भूभारस्य वा ॥२२॥ — This world or the burden of the earth.
22.translation: This world or the burden of the earth.

23-24.word_for_word: एवं विज्ञाप्य कृताभिनन्दनं भगवन्तं नमस्यति द्वयेन---विशुद्ध-विज्ञान-घनम् इति केवलं ज्ञानैक-मूर्तिम् । — After announcing this, he offers his obeisances to the Supreme Personality of Godhead in two ways: He is the only embodiment of knowledge, which is dense in pure knowledge.; अत एव स्व-संस्थया स्वरूप-सम्यक्-स्थित्यैव परमानन्द-रूपया सम्यग् आप्ताः सर्वेऽर्था येन तम् । — That is why, by His own institution, He is the one who has perfectly attained all the meanings in the form of supreme bliss by being in the perfect state of form.; आप्त-कामतोक्ता सत्य-सङ्कल्पताम् आह---अमोघ-वाञ्छितम् इति ॥२३.२४॥ — He who speaks of having attained desire says that he is truly resolved, saying, "It is desired infallible.; ननु वाञ्छा चेद् अस्ति, तर्हि दुर्निवारा संसृतिः ? — If there is desire, then is there an inevitable consciousness?; अत आह---स्व-तेजसा इति । — Therefore he argues that it is by its own effulgence.; चेच् छक्त्या नित्य-निवृत्तो माया-कार्य-रूपो गुण-प्रवाहो यस्मात् तम् । — If by the power of the Chech, the flow of the modes of nature in the form of the work of illusion is eternally withdrawn.; अतो भगवन्तं निरतिशयैश्वर्यम् ईमहि शरणं व्रजेमेति ॥२३॥ — Therefore let us take refuge in the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is endowed with infinite opulence.; ननु त्रि-काल-ज्ञस् त्वं कथं मत्-प्रपञ्चं न जानासि ? — If so, how can you, who knows the three times, not know My world?; जानासि चेत् कथम् अगुण-प्रवहं ब्रवीषि ? — If you know, how can you say that it is a flow of qualities?; तत्राह---त्वाम् इति । — There he says, "You.; ईश्वरम् अन्यस्य वशयितारं स्वाश्रयम् अन्यस्यावशम् अत आत्म-मायया आत्माधीनया मायया विनिर्मिता अशेष-विशेषा महद्-आद्या यादवादि-रूपा वा कल्पना येन तं धुर्यं श्रेष्ठं नतोऽस्मीति ॥२४॥ — I offer my obeisances unto that Supreme Personality of Godhead, who subdues others and who is under the control of others.
23-24.translation: After announcing this, he offers his obeisances to the Supreme Personality of Godhead in two ways: He is the only embodiment of knowledge, which is dense in pure knowledge. That is why, by His own institution, He is the one who has perfectly attained all the meanings in the form of supreme bliss by being in the perfect state of form. He who speaks of having attained desire says that he is truly resolved, saying, "It is desired infallible. If there is desire, then is there an inevitable consciousness? Therefore he argues that it is by its own effulgence. If by the power of the Chech, the flow of the modes of nature in the form of the work of illusion is eternally withdrawn. Therefore let us take refuge in the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is endowed with infinite opulence. If so, how can you, who knows the three times, not know My world? If you know, how can you say that it is a flow of qualities? There he says, "You. I offer my obeisances unto that Supreme Personality of Godhead, who subdues others and who is under the control of others.

26.word_for_word: ननु नारदेन व्योम-वधो न दृष्टः, तत् कथं व्योम-वध-प्रसक्तिर् इति तत्रोच्यते, प्रातर् एव केशि-वधानन्तरं नारदेनोक्तम् अङ्गी-कृत्य पुनस् तथैव पशून् पालयता व्योमो हतः । — If Nārada did not see the killing of Vyoma, how is that applicable to the killing of Vyoma?; यद्वा व्योम-वधः पूर्वम् एव वृत्तोऽपि वेष-धारि-वध-प्रसङ्गाद् अत्रोच्यत इति द्रष्टव्यम् । — It should be noted that the killing of Vyoma, although it has already happened, is mentioned here in connection with the killing of the disguised one.; केचित् पुनः शङ्खचूड-वधात् पूर्वम् एव पठन्ति च । — Some of them read it again before the killing of the conchshell.; तम् आह---एकदेति ॥२६.२७॥ — He said to him, "One.
26.translation: If Nārada did not see the killing of Vyoma, how is that applicable to the killing of Vyoma? It should be noted that the killing of Vyoma, although it has already happened, is mentioned here in connection with the killing of the disguised one. Some of them read it again before the killing of the conchshell. He said to him, "One.

28.word_for_word: मेषायितान् मेष-वद्-आचरितान् स्वयं चोर-वद्-आचरितः सन्न् अपो-वाहापकृष्य निनाय ॥२८॥ — He himself acted like a thief and dragged them away from the flood of water and carried them away.
28.translation: He himself acted like a thief and dragged them away from the flood of water and carried them away.

29.word_for_word: पिदधे छादितवान् ॥२९॥ — He closed it and covered it.
29.translation: He closed it and covered it.

30.word_for_word: शरण-द आश्रय-प्रदः । — Shelter-d shelter-giver.; हरिः सिंह इव ॥३०.३१॥ — Hari is like a lion.
30.translation: Shelter-d shelter-giver. Hari is like a lion.

32.word_for_word: पशु-मारं पशु-मारो यथा भवति तथा । — Killing an animal is like killing an animal.; अनिःश्वासम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३२॥ — It means to be without breath.
32.translation: Killing an animal is like killing an animal. It means to be without breath.

33.word_for_word: पशु-मारं पशु-मारो यथा भवति तथा । — Killing an animal is like killing an animal.; अनिःश्वासम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३३॥ — It means to be without breath.
33.translation: Killing an animal is like killing an animal. It means to be without breath.

34.word_for_word: भुवि गोपैः स्तूयमानः, उपरि वैमानिकैर् देवैर् इति ॥३४॥ — He is praised by the cowherd men on earth and by the gods in the air above.
34.translation: He is praised by the cowherd men on earth and by the gods in the air above.
